Title: Data Engineer Lead
Description: Blend is a premier AI services provider, committed to co-creating meaningful impact for its clients through the power of data science, AI, technology, and people. With a mission to fuel bold visions, Blend tackles significant challenges by seamlessly aligning human expertise with artificial intelligence. The company is dedicated to unlocking value and fostering innovation for its clients by harnessing world-class people and data-driven strategy. We believe that the power of people and AI can have a meaningful impact on your world, creating more fulfilling work and projects for our people and clients. For more information, visit www.blend360.com Job Description The Data Engineer Lead is responsible for designing, developing, and supporting data solutions that enable reporting, business intelligence, and predictive analytics across the organization. The role includes modernizing recurring manual reports by converting Excel workbooks, manual data pulls, and repetitive processes into automated data pipelines and scalable BI solutions. In addition, the role is responsible for supporting the team's predictive model production processes, including model scoring, production data preparation, and ensuring reliable operational execution of analytical models. Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain automated data pipelines and analytics solutions. Automate manual reporting processes and repetitive data workflows. Optimize SQL queries, data models, and processing performance. Support production data preparation and model scoring for predictive analytics. Monitor data quality, troubleshoot pipeline issues, and improve reliability. Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to deliver scalable data solutions. Promote data engineering best practices and drive continuous improvements. Qualifications Required: Strong experience as a Data Engineer, Analytical Data Engineer, Analytics Engineer, BI Developer, Reporting Engineer, or similar role, with a proven track record of designing, automating, and delivering production reporting and analytics solutions. SQL Server and database expertise. Strong SQL Server development and database management skills, including writing complex queries, optimizing performance, and supporting production reporting and analytical workloads. Ability to translate ambiguous business questions into efficient SQL solutions using joins, window functions, CTEs, and sound data modeling principles. Programming and modern data platforms. Proficiency in Python for automation, data processing, and analytical workflows. Experience working with Databricks to develop, maintain, and support production data pipelines and analytics solutions. Business Intelligence development. Demonstrated experience developing reports and dashboards using Tableau or comparable BI tools. Ability to design reporting solutions that are actively used by the business and clearly communicate the purpose and value of each report. End to end automation. Experience taking recurring reporting processes from manual execution to automated production solutions. Comfortable determining when logic belongs in SQL, Python, or another appropriate technology to build scalable and maintainable data workflows. Predictive model production. Experience supporting predictive model production processes, including model scoring, production data preparation, workflow scheduling, monitoring, troubleshooting, and ensuring reliable operational execution of analytical models. Reverse engineering and reconciliation. Ability to interpret an undocumented Excel report, including its filters, joins, date logic, and business rules, and accurately reproduce it. A disciplined approach to reconciling output against a baseline until every discrepancy is explained. Communication with nontechnical stakeholders. Ability to elicit requirements and business rules from report owners who understand what they need but not how it is built. Preferred: Deep Tableau experience (strong report design in Power BI, Looker, or similar accepted) SQL Server or other Microsoft data platforms Experience with Databricks in production analytics environments Dimensional modeling, including reporting marts, conformed dimensions, and shared fact tables Experience modernizing a portfolio of legacy Excel reports Experience supporting predictive model production or machine learning operations in a production environment Experience in hospitality, vacation ownership, or operational reporting Additional Information Our Perks and Benefits: 📚 Learning Opportunities: Certifications in AWS (we are AWS Partners), Databricks, and Snowflake. Access to AI learning paths to stay up to date with the latest technologies. Study plans, courses, and additional certifications tailored to your role. Access to Udemy Business, offering thousands of courses to boost your technical and soft skills. English lessons to support your professional communication. 🛫 Travel opportunities to attend industry conferences and meet clients. 👩‍🏫 Mentoring and Development: Career development plans and mentorship programs to help shape your path. 🎁 Celebrations & Support: Special day rewards to celebrate birthdays, work anniversaries, and other personal milestones. Company-provided equipment. ⚖️ Flexible working options to help you strike the right balance. Other benefits may vary according to your location in LATAM. For detailed information regarding the benefits applicable to your specific location, please consult with one of our recruiters.

Aplicarás tu experiencia para generar soluciones de datos escalables, optimizar flujos de trabajo de datos y colaborar con equipos multifuncionales para asegurar una entrega confiable de datos que apoye iniciativas de analytics y business intelligence. Qué buscamos: - 3+ años de experiencia en desarrollo ETL, ingeniería de datos o campos relacionados. - Sólido conocimiento de SQL, Python y frameworks de procesamiento de datos. - Experiencia con conceptos de data warehousing y plataformas de datos basadas en la nube. - Comprensión de diseño de bases de datos, modelado de datos y optimización de rendimiento. - Familiaridad con sistemas de control de versiones y herramientas de orquestación de pipelines de datos. - Conocimiento de mejores prácticas de aseguramiento de calidad y monitoreo de datos. - Nivel avanzado de inglés. Qué ofrecemos para que tu trabajo (y tu vida) seja mais fácil: - Trabajo 100% remoto: trabaja desde tu casa o donde quieras. - Compensación en USD o en tu moneda local, como prefieras, muy por encima de la media del mercado. - Hardware y software. - Horarios flexibles - Licencias por mater/paternidad, vacaciones y días festivos nacionales pagos. - Ambiente laboral multicultural e innovador, perfecto para hacer amigos, colaborar y aprender de las personas más talentosas del mundo. - Oportunidades de crecimiento y desarrollo profesional a través de mentorías y entrenamientos. ¡Únete a nuestro equipo global!

Title: Demand Planner - Guadalajara, MEX
Description: About this Position We are looking for a Demand Planner to drive forecast accuracy, inventory optimization, and cross-functional alignment across the business. In this role, you will partner closely with Commercial, Marketing, and Supply Chain teams to develop reliable demand plans, support operational decision-making, and ensure product availability while balancing working capital objectives. This is an excellent opportunity for a data-driven professional who enjoys transforming insights into actions and contributing to the continuous improvement of planning processes in a dynamic business environment. What You´ll Do Develop and maintain portfolio segmentation methodologies to improve forecast accuracy across brands and product categories. Build and enhance statistical forecasting models to support short-, medium-, and long-term demand planning. Monitor demand planning KPIs, including Forecast Accuracy (FCA) and BIAS, and implement action plans to improve performance and profitability. Manage inventory health across brands, ensuring optimal product availability while supporting working capital objectives. Lead portfolio reviews and maintain accurate system updates to reflect demand and assortment changes. Strong knowledge of Supply Chain processes, including Demand Planning, Supply Planning, S&OP (Sales & Operations Planning), and IBP (Integrated Business Planning). Advanced Excel and data analytics skills; experience with Power BI is highly preferred. Continuous improvement mindset and ability to work effectively in cross-functional and fast-paced environments. Some perks of joining Henkel Flexible work scheme with flexible hours, hybrid work model, and work from anywhere policy for up to 30 days per year Diverse national and international growth opportunities Global wellbeing standards with health and preventive care programs Gender-neutral parental leave for a minimum of 8 weeks Employee Share Plan with voluntary investment and Henkel matching shares Flexible Benefits Meal vouchers Savings fund Friday early finish At Henkel, we come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe the uniqueness of all our employees is the power in us. Become part of the team and bring your uniqueness to us! We welcome all applications across different genders, origins, cultures, religions, sexual orientations, disabilities, and generations.

Title: AI/ML Engineering
Description: AI/ML Engineering MX - Guadalajara Contract Onsite About the Role We are seeking a Lead AI/ML Engineer to architect, build, and operationalize a full-lifecycle, automated evaluation harness for non-deterministic Generative AI agents deployed across our Cloud GTM space (e.g., deep research, conversational analytics, pipeline forecasting). In this role, you will transition our AI evaluations from manual human reviews to high-throughput automated pipelines backed by LLM-as-a-Judge and targeted human audits. You will work at the intersection of enterprise software engineering, distributed computing, and cutting-edge LLM evaluation frameworks to ensure data integrity, eliminate regressions, and scale our GTM agent capabilities. Key Responsibilities 1. Foundations & Local Sandbox Development • Build robust golden datasets extracted from UAT logs and utilize frontier models to synthetically generate variations (typos, phrasing, syntax) for robust testing. • Construct local developer sandbox environments using the Google ADK framework with version-controlled prompts in Cider. • Generate test scripts and code snippets mapped to defined success metrics for continuous local unit testing. 2. Production Pipeline Automation & System Architecture • Architect and deploy language-agnostic RPC endpoints to systematically invoke GTM agents within the ecosystem. • Build resilient production pipelines supporting parallel inference execution across 1,000+ trajectory datasets in under 15 minutes. • Stand up a centralized Model Context Protocol (MCP) logging server to capture raw prompts, tool trajectories, SQL queries, and token costs using strict JSON schemas. • Implement asynchronous message queues (Pub/Sub) for rate-limiting/backpressure, along with retry policies for network and generation failures. • Establish CI/CD Pull Request (PR) gates that block commits causing capability regressions, and enable pre-production shadow deployments using production mirror traffic. 3. Skill Benchmarking & Trajectory Validation • Author eval test suites to isolate specific agent competencies (e.g., CRM writes, SQL analytics). • Inject sandboxed mocks to validate tool-calling logic without producing live CRM side effects or executing heavy database reads. • Validate multi-turn trajectories, checking chronological tool order, API loop prevention, and exact parameter payload assertions (e.g., date ranges, seller regions). • Stream execution logs for baseline delta analysis and capability scoring. 4. Enterprise Analytics, Governance & Security (Phase 4) • Build low-latency Hydra ETL pipelines to stream structured evaluation JSON records into data warehouses and construct Plx analytics dashboards. • Enforce automated PII masking/redaction layers for sensitive seller and financial data, while configuring retention and purging policies (e.g., 90-day trajectory logs). Required Qualifications & Technical Skills • Core Language: Advanced proficiency in Python. • Software & Systems Architecture: Deep expertise in enterprise software architectures, distributed computing, async task processing, and load balancing. • AI/LLM Telemetry & Evaluations: Proven experience in LLM performance telemetry, prompt engineering, LLM-as-a-Judge systems, and statistical inter-rater agreement (IRR/Kappa). • Tooling & Infrastructure: o Experience with Google ADK (or similar agent developer kits). o Protocol Buffers o Model Context Protocol (MCP) logging architectures. o RPC service design and integration. • CI/CD & Testing: Hands-on experience integrating evaluation pipelines into CI/CD workflows and managing sandboxed unit testing environments. • Data Engineering: Proficiency in building ETL pipelines (Hydra equivalent), structuring JSON telemetry schemas, and creating analytics dashboards (Plx/BI tools). • Data Privacy: Knowledge of automated PII/data-masking strategies and data retention protocols.
